query.name: top_dominators
query.command: oql "SELECT o.@objectId AS id, classof(o).@name AS class, o.@retainedHeapSize AS retained FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS a FROM OBJECTS (dominators(-1)) a) o WHERE o.@retainedHeapSize > 1048576"

query.name: engine_states
query.command: oql "SELECT s.@objectId AS id, classof(s).@name AS class, s.@retainedHeapSize AS retained, eval((SELECT p.partitionId AS pid FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS o FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS inbounds(r) FROM OBJECTS (s) r) o) p WHERE classof(p).@name = \"io.camunda.zeebe.engine.state.ProcessingDbState\"))[0].pid AS partitionId FROM \"io\.camunda\.zeebe\.engine\.state\..*\.Db[A-Za-z]*State\" s"

query.name: decision_states
query.command: oql "SELECT s.@objectId AS id, s.@retainedHeapSize AS retained, s.drgCache.localCache.@objectId AS mapId FROM io.camunda.zeebe.engine.state.deployment.DbDecisionState s"

query.name: caches
query.command: oql "SELECT c.@objectId AS mapId, c.@retainedHeapSize AS retained, c.maxWeight AS maxWeight FROM com.google.common.cache.LocalCache c"

query.name: cache_segments
query.command: oql "SELECT seg.@objectId AS segId, seg.map.@objectId AS mapId, seg.count AS cnt, seg.maxSegmentWeight AS maxSegWeight FROM com.google.common.cache.LocalCache$Segment seg"

query.name: drg_entries
query.command: oql "SELECT e.@objectId AS entryId, e.key.drgKey.value AS drgKey, e.valueReference.referent.@retainedHeapSize AS retained, dominatorof(e).@objectId AS segId FROM com.google.common.cache.LocalCache$StrongAccessEntry e WHERE e.key.drgKey != null"

query.name: deployed_drgs
query.command: oql "SELECT d.@objectId AS id, d.@retainedHeapSize AS retained FROM io.camunda.zeebe.engine.state.deployment.DeployedDrg d"

query.name: deployed_processes
query.command: oql "SELECT p.@objectId AS id, p.@retainedHeapSize AS retained FROM io.camunda.zeebe.engine.state.deployment.DeployedProcess p"
